reuse.why: Fintegra links through the existing linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank, and the takeover reuses the column reset extracted from unlinkAccount; only the download function follows the copy-per-provider pattern.

duplication.why: The unlink column reset is extracted into clearAccountBankLink and shared with unlinkAccount, and the guards are one helper; downloadFintegraTransactions is still a copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.

placement.why: Guard and reset sit beside linkBankSyncAccount in accounts/app.ts and run before any bank row is created; the closed-account rule is tucked into a helper named only for the already-linked rule.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the linking rules, the Fintegra provider wiring and tests for them.

maintainability.why: One guard call per handler plus the shared linking helper keeps providers uniform; the helper name understates the closed-account check and the boolean flag switches it into a mutating path.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts is a compacted copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (inlined objects, dropped 'error' branch) rather than a shared download helper

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked (accounts/app.ts) accumulates the closed-account branch and the replaceExistingLink flag with its takeover branch; all six link handlers call it
